basic_info.description: NEW PRICE!   Welcome to 300 3rd Street, Unit 918, a spacious and modern condo nestled in the heart of San Francisco's vibrant Yerba Buena neighborhood. This rare gem boasts one of the largest floorplans in the sought-after Museum Parc, offering 2 large bedrooms & 2 bathrooms. Step into an open-plan living & dining area filled with loads of natural light & enjoy the dynamic backdrop of the downtown SF skyline from your private balcony terrace.This stylish residence features an in unit washer/dryer. Residents benefit from premium building amenities, including 24/7 security, a dedicated doorman with package service, & an Amazon room. Stay fit with special access to Crunch Fitness, complete with a heated lap pool, for a discounted fee. Underground parking is available for an additional fee, with direct elevator access from the garage to your condo.Enjoy the convenience of being in a bustling neighborhood, surrounded by a diverse array of restaurants & entertainment venues. With easy access to Muni, BART, CalTrain, and tech shuttles, commuting to the Financial District, Union Square, the Embarcadero, and Mission Bay is a breeze. Don't miss this opportunity for exquisite luxury living in one of San Francisco's most desirable location!
